d: Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi has reportedly been given 74 lashes for an online performance in which she sang without wearing a hijab and performed alongside male musicians. The punishment follows a legal battle that began after her 2024 Caravansarai concert went viral, challenging Iran's restrictions on women and artistic expression. In this video, Firstpost examines the case against Ahmadi, the charges brought by Iranian authorities and the sentence that also includes a two-year ban on artistic activities and leaving the country.
